Short title extent and commencement

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called the National Book
Foundation Act, 1972. .
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once. .

Definitions

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
2.
Definitions. ‑‑In
this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "books" shall include textbooks,
reference books and other books on religion and other books and reading material
for use by students and the general public ; and
(b) "foundation" means the Foundation
established under this Act.

Establishment of the foundation

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
3.
Establishment 'of the Foundation.--(1) As soon as may be after the commencement of this
Act, the. Federal Government may, for the purpose of making books available at
moderate prices, by notification in the official Gazette, establish a National
Book Foundation, hereinafter referred to as the Foundation.
(2) The. Foundation shall be a body, corporate
having perpetual succession, and a, common seal with power to acquire, hold and
dispose of property, both movable and immovable.

Constitution of the foundation

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
4.
Constitution of the‑Foundation.‑(1) The management, overall
control and supervision of the affairs of the Foundation shall vest in a, Board
of Governors consisting of the following members, namely :‑
(1) the Minister for Education and Provincial Co‑ordination,
who shall, also be the Chairman of the. Board; ,
(2) the Secretary, Ministry of Education and
Provincial Co-ordination ;
(3) one‑ representative of
each of the Provinces ;
(4) one representative of the areas not forming part
of any Province to be appointed by the Federal Government ;
(5) a representative of the University Grants
Commission ;
(6) the Chairman, Committee of Chairmen of Education
Board;
(7) (i) five persons to be appointed by the Federal
Government from, amongst eminent educationists, scholars, scientists, men, of
letters and' persons connected with education or the production of books ;
(ii) live representatives of whom one shall be %
female to be elected by the National Assembly of Pakistan from amongst
themselves ;
(8) the Managing Director of the foundation,, to be.
appointed by the Federal Government ; and ,
(9) the Secretary of the Foundation, to be appointed
by the Federal Government.
(2) The members of the Board of Governors, other
than the ex officio. members, shall
hold office for three years and shall be eligible for re?appointment.
(3) The office of the Foundation shall be at
Islamabad.

Managing director

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
5. Managing Director
.‑The Managing Director shall be the chief executive officer of the
Foundation and shall, subject to the general supervision of the Chairman of the
Board of Governors, be responsible for carrying out the objects of the
Foundation as laid down by the Board from, time to time.

Functions  of the foundation

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
6. Functions of the Foundation.‑The following
shall be the functions of the Foundation, naively :‑
(a) to receive any money .or financial grants from
the Federal Govern ment. the Provincial Governments, local bodies and any
statutory or non -statutory corporation ;
(b) to collect, accept or otherwise receive from any
person, body. association, institution of organization any subscription or
donation made to the Foundation ;
(c) to undertake writing of books and 1o encourage
writers to produce good books ;
(d) to undertake the translation of foreign and
locally‑produced books Into the national and regional languages of the
country and vice versa ;
(e) to arrange the original publication and re‑production
of local books as well as those published abroad ;
(f) to import foreign books and to undertake the,
distribution of books among the educational institutions and the general public
;
(g) to encourage the .writers and the book trade in
general fin the pro duction of books and making them available to the students
and the general public at moderate prices ;
(h) to provide technical know‑how and
financial assistance and to take other steps aimed at fostering interest in
books and in reading; and
(i) to initiate such other activities and programmes
as may assist in the task of book development, book promotion, advancement of
literacy .and dissemination of knowledge by means of the printed word.

Audit

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
7. Audit.‑The accounts of the Foundation shall
be audited annually by the Auditor‑General of Pakistan and the balance‑sheet
and statements .of assets and liabilities shall be duly considered by the Board
of Governors.

Power to make rules

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
8. Power to make rules.‑The Foundation may
make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act.

Repeal

ACT XIX OF 1972
ACT XIX OF 1972
NATIONAL
BOOK FOUNDATION ACT, 1972
9. Repeal. ‑The National Book Foundation
Ordinance, 1972 (XXVI of :1972), is hereby repealed.
